hooks.command: if [ -n "${TMUX:-}" ] && [ -n "${TMUX_PANE:-}" ] && [ "$(tmux show-environment -t "$TMUX_PANE" GC_DRAIN_ACK 2>/dev/null)" = GC_DRAIN_ACK=1 ]; then echo "This sitting has ended (its tab reads done), so it is not compacted." >&2; exit 2; fi; S="${GC_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}/.claude/hooks/converse-compact.md"; [ -f "$S" ] && cat "$S"; exit 0

export PATH="$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; for C in "${GC_RIG_ROOT:-}" "${GC_CITY_PATH:-}/rigs/gc-toolkit"; do S="$C/assets/scripts/gh-origin-guard.sh"; [ -x "$S" ] && exec sh "$S"; done; exit 0
